name: Payment Record
documentation: A data object representing a single payment transaction record persisted in the relational database. Defined by the 'payment_records' table in the SQL schema. Contains the fields: id (primary key, VARCHAR 64), account_id (VARCHAR 64, not null), amount (DECIMAL 10,2, not null), and created_at (TIMESTAMP, defaulting to current time). This data object is read and written by the Process Payment Transaction application function.
